Commentary.Commentary: It seems to be drizzling a bit and the groundsmen are handy with the covers. Let's hope the weather behaves and we have an uninterrupted spell of cricket. Join us shortly as the Kangaroos get ready to chase down the Lankan's score.

The Australian bowlers looked happy on the slower pitch and no one looked more comfortable than Hastings. His six-wicket haul was instrumental in restricting the Lankans. The others were not as prolific in terms of picking wickets but they were economical and created pressure from the other end.

From that precarious position, the lower-middle order persevered and slowly added to the runs. Sachith Pathirana was involved in a couple of vital stands which helped Sri Lanka cross the 200-run mark. Towards the end, Mathews made a heroic return and gave his side the push they needed to end on 212.

Brilliant bowling performance from Australia. Electing to bat, Sri Lanka were off to a very shaky beginning with three wickets down and 31 runs on the board but de Silva and skipper Mathews ensured they go past the tough situation with an 84-run partnership. Things got worse for the Lankans when a calf injury brought Angelo low and the hosts lost three quick wickets soon after.

OUT! HASTINGS ENDS WITH A 6-FER! He delivers yet another short ball in this over, around off, Mathews tries to power it over covers but gets a top edge on it. The ball balloons in the air and Bailey settles underneath at point to complete the catch. SRI LANKA ARE ALL OUT FOR 212! Not good scenes as Mathews is been helped off the field by a couple of Sri Lankan players. Really struggling with his calf.

Good piece of fielding by Head! A fuller length ball outside off, Mathews goes deep inside the crease and rockets it over covers. Head in the deep makes an outstanding sliding stop. Well done by Mathews as well, as he limps back for the second run.
Play and a miss! Slower short ball around leg, Mathews hops back to hit it through the off side but fails to make any connection.
FOUR! Smashed away! Hastings is becoming very predictive with his length, Mathews lines himself behind this half-tracker and hammer-pulls it to the deep mid-wicket fence.
Hastings digs in another short ball, this time Mathews fails to connect with his attempted pull shot.
Short ball on middle, pulled on the leg side but straight to mid-wicket.
Driven towards the mid on region. They pick up a single.
Shortish on off, pushed off the back foot to the off side.
FOUR! Boom! Stand and deliver! This is right in the slot for Mathews, he is moving a bit gingerly but shows no pain there as he puts that away down to long on for a cracking boundary.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. No run.
Lands it full and around off, it's driven down the ground for a single.
Fullish on off, Aponso pushes it back to the bowler.
AMILA APONSO walks in next as the last batsman for Sri Lanka.

OUT! MAIDEN FIFER FOR HASTINGS! He lets out yet another slower delivery, on a fuller length and outside off, Pathirana gets across the stumps and tries to clear long off. However, he fails to back his shot with good timing and gets caught by Faulkner in the deep. End of a handy little knock by Sachith!
Slower length ball on middle and off, Pathirana gets back and keeps it out to covers.
Once again connects with the pull shot and this time he limps to the other end as the deep mid-wicket fielder does the fielding job.
It has started to rain. Let's see for how long the umpires can carry on with the game. Maybe, they are expecting it to be just a passing shower.
Short in length on middle, Mathews pulls it on the leg side but straight to mid-wicket.
Hastings digs in a short ball around leg, Mathews goes for the hook shot but fails to connect. He is struggling which is quite evident.
ANGELO MATHEWS returns to the crease. He does not look comfortable and is still limping.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Wicket No. 4 for Hastings! Bouncer and around off, Dilruwan looks to pull it but misjudges the bounce. The ball gets a thin outside edge and gets a thin outside edge. The ball goes to Wade behind the stumps and the keeper is only too happy to pouch it.
HASTINGS to bowl.
Full around off, driven down the ground for a single.
Full outside off, driven to mid off for a single.
On the pads, flicked to the leg side for a single.
BEATEN! Fuller ball outside off, Dilruwan looks to play it but the ball beats his outside edge.
Fuller ball outside off, defended to the off side for a single.
Low full toss wide outside off, Dilruwan reaches across and drives it  through point. The batsmen run hard and get a triple.
Fuller ball on the pads, worked to mid-wicket for a single. That ends Mitchell Starc's overs.
In the channel outside off, Dilruwan tries to defend it but misses.
FOUR! Fullish ball on the pads, a little too straight, and Dilruwan is able to flick it to the fine leg boundary.
Full outside off, firmly driven through the covers for a couple.
Low full toss on middle, the ball swings in and Pathirana gets an inside edge to the leg side for a single.
Full outside off, driven to the covers for a single.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. No run to end the over.
Fullish and on off, Pathirana lofts it over wide mid off for a couple of runs.

Another slower delivery on off, Perera taps it down with soft hands to point and crosses for a quick single. In case of a direct hit by Bailey at the non-striker's end, Pathirana would have been run out.
Beautifully bowled slower delivery, it's angled across the batsman and Perera fails to run it down to third man.
Slower delivery outside off, a touch short in length, Pathirana runs it down and now there is a third man in place. Hence only a single conceded.
Slower cutter on middle, it's tucked through square leg for a single.
JAMES FAULKNER is back into the attack.

EDGY FOUR! Starc bowls a back of a length ball on off, Pathirana has a push inside the line and the outside edge screams wide of the keeper and short third man for a boundary. Good over for Sri Lanka, 12 runs off it!
FIVE WIDES! Starc loses his radar and slips a full ball way down the leg side. The batsman and the keeper miss and the ball goes on to meet the fine leg fence.
Full and angling down the leg side, it's flicked through square leg for a run.
Perera has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
On a length and outside off, dabbed to third man for one.
Bangs in a very sharp full ball on middle, Perera tries to flick but but it takes the leading edge and flies over point for a single.
Length ball outside off, Dilruwan looks to play it but is beaten.
STARC is back on.
Short and wide outside off, guided to third man for a single.
Outside off, played to point.
BEATEN! A tad outside off, Perera looks to defend it but the ball beats his outside edge.
Fuller ball outside off, defended off the back foot.
DILRUWAN PERERA is the new man in.

OUT! STRAIGHT TO THE FIELDER! Thisara doesn't get away with it this time. Short and wide outside off, Thisara cuts it powerfully to the covers. He did not put much thought into that stroke and it goes straight to Aaron Finch, who doesn't have to move a muscle to catch that.
Thisara rocks onto the backfoot and punches the ball.
HASTINGS to bowl.
Full around off, flickly firmly through mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball outside off, Pathirana sticks his bat out and gingerly plays it to point for a single.
Pathirana is beaten again by the slower ball as it spins away.
BEATEN! CLOSE CALL! Length ball on off, Pathirana looks to play it, misses and the ball goes over the stumps.
Slower and shorter, wide outside off, Pathirana flashes and misses.

BIG APPEAL FOR A CATCH! Not given. Slower delivery, on a length and outside off, Pathirana winds up for a big shot but fails to middle it. There is some sound as it goes into the gloves of Wade and they appeal vociferously. The umpire though turns down the appeal. The replays show there was a nick.
Taps a length ball down to point for a single.
Outside off, play and a miss for Pathirana.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Short delivery outside off, Thisara goes for a hard chop to the off side and gets a single for his effort.
Short ball outside off, Thisara plays it to mid off.
The batsman rocks onto the backfoot and punches the ball.
POWER PLAY 3 - 5 fielders allowed outside the circle now.
Fuller ball outside off, Pathirana looks to defend it but misses.
Full outside off, driven to mid off for a single.
Length delivery, narrowly outside off, Thisara looks to play is but misses the line of the delivery.
Length ball outside off, Pathirana plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man for a single.
BEATEN! Shortish ball outside off again, this time Pathirana's shot it beaten comprehensively.
FOUR! EDGED! Short outside off, Pathirana looks to cut it but the ball takes an outside edge and goes through the slips and makes it to the third man boundary.
JAMES FAULKNER is back on.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.

DROPPED! Length ball outside off, Thisara looks to cut it off the back foot. The ball goes to George Bailey at backward point. It goes straight to him and he crouches down to take it but the ball bounces out of his hands.
Bouncer! Thisara ducks well in time to let it go over him.
Fuller ball outside off, driven towards mid off.
Shorter ball on middle and off, Thisara defends it off the back foot back to the bowler.
Fullish ball outside off, Pathirana goes for a lofted driven through extra cover for a single.
Fuller ball on middle and off, well defended by Thisara.
FOUR! AGGRESSIVELY DONE! Another full toss on middle and off, Pathirana stands back and punches it through mid off. The fielder tries to stop it but the ball gets past and across the ropes.
Full toss on middle and leg, Pathirana gets his bat up and nudges it to square leg for a single.
Fuller ball on middle, worked to square leg.
Full on off, driven through mid on.
BEATEN! Fuller ball outside off, Pathirana looks to loft it but misses.
Bouncer! Thisara sees it coming early and ducks.
Fuller ball outside off, pushed to mid off.
Wide outside off, Thisara goes to play it but misses.
Full on middle, pushed down the ground to David Warner at mid off for a single. He misfields it again and we get a glimpse of his frustration in his throw.
Fuller ball outside off, pushed through the covers.
Pathirana has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
BOLAND is back on.
Length ball around off, punched through the off side.
Third wide of the over! Wide outside off, Thisara tries to cut it but it is too wide. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Full delivery, defended off the front foot. The batsmen run a single and there is a throw at the bowler's end but the batsman was never in any danger.
Full ball on off, Pathirana drives it down the ground.
Wide! Another delivery down the leg side, Pathirana leaves it. The umpire signals a wide.
Another full delivery outside off, driven through mid off.
Very full on off, driven to mid off.
Wide! This time the umpire signals a wide as the ball goes down the leg side.
The ball is too wide on the off side for Pathirana to make any contact.
Australia is going in for the kill. They bring MITCHELL STARC back on.
Flighted on off, Thisara gets forward in defense but is beaten by the away spin.
Four byes! Big spin back into the batsman, Thisara winds up for a big shot but fails to make any connection. It beats the leg stump by a whisker and races away to the fine leg fence.
FOUR! Bang! Shortish ball on off, Thisara goes deep inside the crease and whacks it wide of long off for a cracking boundary.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Forces a full ball with the turn to long on for a single.
Flighted on middle, helped to mid-wicket.
Served outside off, Pathirana square cuts it for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
SACHITH PATHIRANA is the next batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Full on the stumps, Kusal bounds forward and looks to drive it. It makes contact with the bottom of the bat and doesn't go through mid off as planned. Instead, it is flighted to David Warner at cover, who takes a comfortable catch to send Kusal walking back into the hutch.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full on off, driven through mid off for a single.
Full on middle, Kusal charges forward and drives it past the bowler for a single.
Full on the stumps, driven through mid on.
Landed on the pads, worked to square leg for a single.
Length ball on the pads, flicked to the leg side for a single.
THISARA PERERA walks in to bat.

OUT! TOP EDGED! That is the first wicket for Zampa! It is a short ball on off and Angelo goes for the pull shot. The spin throws him off and he gets a top edge on that one. It falls at backward square leg and Matthew Wade runs in and waits to secure it with his gloved hands. Sri Lanka are five men down and looking shaky out there.
Shortish ball outside off, it holds its line and Angelo plays it to the off side.
Tossed up on middle and leg, defended to square leg for a single.
ADAM ZAMPA is back on.
Full around off, Kusal comes forward and drives it through mid off for a single.
Landed on off, defended off the front foot.
Loopy full toss outside off, driven through the covers.
Tossed up on leg, worked to square leg for a single.
Flighted on middle and leg, flicked to the leg side.
Full outside off, driven to mid off.
TRAVIS HEAD comes into the attack.
Short outside off, punched off the back foot to the off side for a single.
Full on middle and leg, driven through mid on.
Bouncer! Angelo ducks in time to let that one go over him.
Full ball around off, superbly driven through the covers for a single.
Length ball on middle and leg, punched off the back foot.
Shortish ball outside off, Angelo looks to play it with a slightly open face. He helps it to third man for a single.
Angled away and outside off, Kusal looks to play it but misses.
Fuller ball outside off, Kusal looks to drive it but gets an inside edge that goes to mid-wicket.
Shortish ball outside off, cut through point.
The batsman guides it to third man. They pick up a single.
Outside off, Kusal  opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man for a single.
Fuller ball outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
KUSAL PERERA is the new man in.

OUT! That one went sky high! Short around off, de Silva's eyes light up and he goes to drag his pull through the leg side. His pull goes awry and he gets a top edge that sends the ball skyward but not far enough. It returns to the ground at short mid-wicket and Aaron Finch is there to greet it with cupped hands. Australia are into the lower-middle order now with two new batsmen at the crease.
Good length ball outside off, pushed through mid off for a single.
Shorter ball on middle, blocked off the back foot to the bowler.
Length ball around off, de Silva flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length ball outside off, defended off the back foot.
Length ball outside off, de Silva lofts it but doesn't get his contact right and the ball goes over point for a couple.
Full ball around off, driven through mid on.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Full outside off, punched off the back foot.
Shortish ball outside off, played to point.
Full on middle and off, driven through mid on for a single.
Angelo Mathews is retired hurt. He is not comfortable with his calf injury and Angelo Perera takes his place.
Length ball outside off, Mathews looks to play it but the ball beats the bat's outside edge.
SCOTT BOLAND is back on.
Full around off, it's been driven superbly through the covers.
Mathews goes for a run and starts hobbling. It seems like a leg injury, something he has a history for and the physio is on the field. That doesn't look good at all. The physio is taping his calf.

Fullish ball on middle and leg, Mathews flicks it to backward square leg for a single. He starts a run but starts hopping on one foot. He looks to be in pain but completes the run and then is attended by the physio.
On leg and fuller in length, worked down the leg side for a single.
Length ball on the pads, de Silva works it down the leg side for a couple.

SMACKED! Fuller ball outside off, Angelo dance down the track and lofts it powerfully over mid off for a triple. It looks like it will definitely go for a boundary but the fielder in the deep chases it down and makes a running scoop just inside the ropes. Excellently stopped to save a run.
Fuller ball around off, defended off the front foot back to the bowler.
HASTINGS is back on.
Gets on the front foot to a full ball and pushes it through covers for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Up and just over the fielder! A full length ball is angled into the batsman, de Silva gets forward and chips it just over the cover fielder. Warner gives it the chase from mid off but fumbles while trying to pick up the ball with a slide. Head who had ran from sweeper cover to stop the ball, overruns a bit and it's Warner who recovers and picks up the ball to throw it back in play. Three runs taken.
Wide! Wrong line, slips a length ball down the leg side, de Silva leaves it alone.
Too full on this occasion, wide outside off, de Silva reaches out for it and squeezes it out to point.
FOUR! Shot! Starc angles in a fuller length ball on off, de Silva gets forward and lofts it through the line. He makes fine connection and it flies over mid off for a boundary.
Goes on the back foot in defense.
Tossed up outside off, Angelo has pushed it to the cover region.
Flighted outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
Short outside off, punched off the back foot for a single.
FOUR! HOOKED! Short around off, the skipper leans back and pulls it powerfully behind square leg for a boundary.
Full delivery, driven through mid off.
Full ball on the stumps, driven down the ground for a single.
Played to the point region by the batsman. No run.
Starc lands it full and outside off, it's driven square of the wicket on the off side for a single.

FOUR! Neatly done! Starc errs in his line and serves a fuller length ball around middle and leg, de Silva picks it off his pads and nudges it fine down the leg side for a boundary. He has impressed so far with his calm and composed approach.
Starc continues from round the wicket... He bowls it from wide of the crease and attempts to spear in a yorker, however, it reaches on the full to the batsman who just digs it out on the off side.
On a length and outside off, Mathews taps it down in the gap at cover-point for a quick single.
Starc comes from round the wicket and angles in a full ball on off, Mathews gets on the front foot in defense.
MITCHELL STARC is back on.
NOT OUT! Flatter ball on off, pushed through the off side. The man at point runs forward and gets a direct throw at the non-stiker's end but the batsman is well in.
Run out appeal referred to the umpire upstairs.
De Silva has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Shorter ball on middle and off, pulled through the leg side for a single.
Full and angled in, defended behind the line of the delivery.
Full outside off, pushed to the covers.

NOT OUT! DECISION STANDS! Flighted ball on leg, the ball spins in enough to beat the inside edge of Mathews' bat. It rides up his pads and the fielding side appeals loudly. The umpire doesn't agree though. Zampa is sure of himself and decides to go in for a review. The replay shows that it was a fair delivery and the impact with the pad is with the umpire's call. Ball tracking clears things up by showing that the ball was missing leg.
Appeal for an lbw! It's not entertained by the umpire and Australia go for the review.
Fuller ball, it swings in and hits de Silva on the pads. The fielding side appeals but it isn't enough to interest the umpire.
Fuller ball outside off and de Silva looks to guide it again but misses.
Dhananjay plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. They manage to come back for the second.
Length ball outside off, de Silva looks to play it but is beaten.
50-run stand between Mathews and de Silva! Back of a length ball on off, Angelo guides it to third man again for a single.
Outside off, de Silva opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man for a single.
On middle and off, turning in, played off the front foot.
Full on middle, defended off the front foot.
A grunt from Zampa as he tosses it up on the pads, de Silva flicks it to square leg for a single.

Well inside! Landed off off, Mathews plays it off the front foot and the ball goes to the off side. The batsmen run a single and there is a direct throw at the non-striker's end but the batsman is well inside.
Shorter ball outside off, Mathews looks to cut it but gets a bottom edge to point.
Maiden ODI fifty for Dhananjaya de Silva!
Flighted outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
Lands it on a fuller length around off, Mathews presses forward in defense.
Fullish and on middle, knocked down through mid on for a run.
Wayward line, full and drifting down the leg side, Mathews tucks it through square leg for a single.
Wide called for height! Boland bangs it short around off and Angelo sways away from the line. It goes way over the head of the batsman and the square leg umpire signals a wide.
Boland goes full with his length and serves it closer to the off stump line, Mathews gets half-forward and defends it to the off side.
FOUR! Great shot by the Lankan skipper! He shimmies down the track to a full ball, mid on and mid off are inside the circle and he just smashes it over the head of the mid on fielder for a boundary.
Full in length on middle, de Silva turns it through the gap at square leg for a single.
SCOTT BOLAND is back on.
Full and tossed up, Mathews does well to drive it back to the bowler.
Flatter delivery on off, punched off the back foot for a single.
Tossed up around off, driven down the ground.
Tossed up around off, driven through the covers.
Short delivery around off, the skipper cuts it through the off side for a single. Hastings, at point, makes a fantastic dive to save the runs.
Full outside off, pushed to the covers.
FOUR! Delicately done! Shorter ball on middle and leg, de Silva plays a glancing stroke that sends the ball through fine leg for a boundary.
Length ball on off, defended off the front foot.

Full delivery around off, driven down the ground through mid off for a single. The man in the deep throws it at the bowler's end but it is wide off the mark and Mathews has to duck to avoid it. He stumbles and falls. Warner, meanwhile, is absent-mindedly clapping his hands.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Fuller ball outside off, driven straight down the ground.
Length ball around off, defended off the front foot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. One run added to the total.
Flighted delivery on middle and off, driven back down the pitch.
Tossed up on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Full on the stumps, driven back to the bowler.
Full delivery around off, driven to mid off for a single.

Excellently fielded! Fuller ball outside off, Mathews dead bats to the off side. Warner charges in as the batsmen run a single. He doesn't manage to pick up the ball but if he did, that would have been a run out chance for sure.
Wide! Floated past the batsman's legs, Mathews leaves it. The umpire signals a wide.
Length ball outside off, the batsman looks to play it but lets it go at the last moment.
Length ball on middle and leg, worked down the leg side for a single.
BEATEN! That was a beauty! Around the wicket, Faulkner bowls a length ball a tad outside off and beats the outside edge of Mathews' defence.
Fuller on the stumps, pushed back to the bowler.
Length ball on middle and off, shaping in, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller ball outside off, played off the front foot to the covers.
Full outside off, pushed to the covers.
Served around off, pushed to the covers for a single.
De Silva has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full on middle and off, driven through mid off for a single.
Tossed up delivery, defended off the front foot.
Loopy full toss on middle, driven through mid on for a single.
Adam Zampa to roll his arm over.
Length ball, defended from within the crease.
Defended off the front foot by Mathews presenting the full face of the bat.
Full around off, driven down the ground.
Short outside off, Mathews looks to play it but misses.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
On the pads, de Silva guides it fine down the leg side for a couple.
Bouncer! Mathews is greeted by a slower bouncer again which he ducks under.

Angelo Mathews has taken a blow on the back of the helmet and seems rattled. The Aussies check for his well being and the Sri Lankan skipper smiles and gives a thumbs up. Thank God for helmets. Physio comes out to have a look as well. And the umpires have decided to take drinks in the meantime.

OUCH! That once is sure to hurt Angelo. Shortish ball on the stumps, Mathews ducks but he takes his eyes off the ball and misjudges the bounce. He takes a hit solidly on his helmet. That one looks bad and the Aussies are concerned too.
Short outside off, de Silva miscues it to the off side for a single.
FOUR! Good length ball on the pads, de Silva waits for it and flicks it through fine leg. There are no fielders waiting and the ball crosses the ropes.
Shortish delivery around off, de Silva looks to cut it but gets an inside edge.
Shorter ball outside off, played to point.
Wide! Bouncer on middle, de Silva lets it through. The umpire thinks that one was too high up and signals a wide.
Length ball outside off, de Silva guides it to third man for a single.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
Short ball a tad outside off, Mathews defends it off the back foot.
Full on the stumps, Mathews has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Shaping away a bit, defended off the back foot.
Fuller on middle, defended off the back foot with the full face of the bat.
Fuller ball, defended off the front foot to cover.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! FLICKED! Cleanly done by de Silva. Fuller ball on the pads, de Silva works it through mid-wicket. He hits it very cleanly and the ball gets airbourne to fly to the fence.
FOUR! DOWN THE GROUND! Full on middle, de Silva steps forward and drives it hard. The ball flies off the bat like an arrow and goes absolutely straight down the ground to find the boundary.
Full on the stumps, driven towards mid off.
Fuller on middle and leg, flicked to the leg side for a single.
Power play 2 - There are 5 players allowed in the 30-yard circle.
De Silva has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full on middle and off, driven through mid off.
Wide! Down the leg side, de Silva looks to flick it but misses. Wide signalled by the umpire.
De Silva rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Full on middle, driven through mid on.

CLOSE SHAVE! Length delivery around leg, the ball swings away and beats de Silva's bat to hit him low on the pads. There is a big cry and it looks like a distinct possibility but the umpire isn't interested. Replays show that the ball pitched outside leg.
Shorter ball around off, de Silva does well to punch that one off the back foot.
JAMES FAULKNER to bowl.
Back of a length ball on off, Mathews remains backward as he defends it down safely.
ANGELO MATHEWS walks in next with his team in trouble.

OUT! That's a massive breakthrough for Australia! Chandimal has been the batsman in form for Sri Lanka and bailed out the hosts in many occasions in the recent past. The Aussies will be very relieved at the moment. Boland serves a length delivery wide outside off, Chandimal camps back to slap it through the line but there is some extra bounce and it takes a faint outside edge. Wade collects the ball, appeals and the finger goes up. A rare failure for Chandimal.
Shortish on off, Chandimal goes on the back foot and taps it down.
Chandimal has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fuller again and Chandimal plays a good looking cover drive. Fails to find the gap though.
Full and outside off, pushed to covers.
SCOTT BOLAND comes into the attack for the first time.
Back of a length ball outside off, defended off the back foot with the full face of the bat.
Short delivery, de Silva pulls it through the leg side for a couple.
Back of a length ball on middle and off, defended off the back foot.
De Silva works it down the leg side. Two runs added to the total.
Fuller on off, punched through the off side.

FOUR! LOFTED! De Silva shows his graceful side with that shot. Fuller ball outside off, de Silva hits that one on the up, lofting it over the covers. The ball soars high and makes it across the ropes.
Full on the stumps, driven to mid on.
FOUR! SLASHED! Short and outside off, Chandimal punches it off the back foot through the covers for a boundary.
Starc switches up his lengths and gets the better of Chandimal. Fuller ball outside off, Dinesh looks to drive but misses.
Full ball, driven back to the bowler.
Short outside off, Chandimal sways back to avoid it.
Wide outside off, that was an easy leave for Dinesh.
Length ball on middle, defended from within the crease.
Fullish ball on the stumps, played to mid-wicket for a single.
Shortish delivery, defended off the back foot.
The same line again and Chandimal's outside edge is beaten.
DINESH CHANDIMAL is the next batsman in.

OUT! DECISION OVERTURNED! Superb review by Mathew Wade. This was a beautiful length delivery just outside off enough to lure Mendis into playing it. He prods forward with the bat and the ball appears to whistle past the outside edge. It goes to the keeper who snatches it up and jumps in jubiliation. Hastings doesn't appeal and the umpire isn't impressed.   Wade is confident though and Australia don't waste any time going in for the review. The replays show that the ball took a slight edge on its way and the umpire raises his finger.
Australia appeal for a caught behind of Mendis but the umpire doesn't give it and they decide to go for the review.
Length ball outside off, Mendis shoudlers his arms.
Length ball outside off, de Silva misjudges the swing and leans too far out to play it and misses.
Low full toss outside off, de Silva makes a well considered push through the covers but doesn't manage to find the gap.
Short delivery, de Silva defends it from within the crease.
Length ball a tad outside off, defended to point.
Full on the pads, flicked to the leg side.
Landed outside off with some extra bounce, Mendis rears up and looks to play it but gets a top edge to point for a single.
On a length and outside off, tapped down to point.
Straighter in line, de Silva turns it through backward square leg for a couple of runs.

EDGY FOUR! On a length and around off, de Silva tries to force it through the line from the crease but it takes the outside edge and runs through the vacant first slip region for a boundary. There was a slip in the first over but Warner decided not to have one for this. Would have been an easy catch. As a bowler, you need to give confidence to your captain by bowling consistent lines. Hastings was quite wayward and that's why Warner decided to remove the slip fielder and strengthen the off side field.
Good length ball on off, de Silva goes on the back foot and defends it down safely.

Hastings is on the shorter side, outside off, de Silva stands back and slaps it through backward point. The third man fielder runs across to his right and stops the ball from touching the ropes. They take a couple of runs.
Full in length and around off, de Silva gets on the front foot and defends it to the off side.
Bouncer! De Silva ducks to avoid it.
Full on middle and off, driven to Usman Khawaja at mid on. He misfields it and the batsmen get a single.
Full around off, driven through mid off.
Good length ball outside off, de Silva looks to cut it but gets a bottom edge and the ball is deflected on to the ground and to the keeper.
Fuller ball down the leg side, Mendis is struck on his thigh pad and the ball goes behind square leg. The umpire signals a leg bye.
Full outside off and angling away, Mendis looks to drive but misses.
FOUR! PUNCHED! De Silva doesn't let that one go. Short and wide outside off, he stays back and punches it through the covers for a boundary.
Length ball around off, de Silva looks to cut it but gets a bottom edge.
Shorter ball around off, de Silva looks to cut it but gets an inside edge and the ball hits his pads.
Wide! Down the leg side, de Silva looks to cut it but misses. The umpire has signalled a wide.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Length ball on off, de Silva looks to play it but gets a bottom edge.
Fuller ball on the stumps, defended off the back foot.
Wide! Well outside off, it is an easy leave for de Silva.
JOHN HASTINGS to bowl from the other end.
Short and outside off, Mendis looks to play it but it beats his outside edge.
Shorter ball outside off, left alone.
KUSAL MENDIS is the new man in.

OUT! STARC STRIKES! Once again, Mitchell gets Oz off to a flying start. Length ball on middle, Avishka is slow to bring his bat down to defend it. The ball shapes in and smacks into his pads. He was much too late to play it. That one was dead plumb and the opener will walk off. A disappointing debut by the talented batsman.
Fullish ball on off, defended off the front foot.
Fuller ball on leg, de Silva looks to play it but is hit on the pads. The batsmen run a single to get Sri Lanka off the mark but the umpire signals a leg bye.
Length ball outside off, de Silva leaves it.

The players and umpires are in the middle. The talented youngster Avishka Fernando and Dhananjaya de Silva to open the batting. The Aussies have a huddle and Mitchell Starc will begin the bowling proceedings with two slips in place. Here we go...

Australian captain, David Warner says that they would have batted first since it is a dry wicket. Shaun Marsh has been replaced by Usman Khawaja since he has a broken finger. (About the last match) He praises his side's bowling and says that his team has adjusted well to the conditions.

Sri Lankan captain, Angelo Mathews says that they will be playing on the same track so as the day goes by they will try to add more runs. He says that they will play it as it goes. He has made three changes to the side - Dilshan, Gunathilaka and Prasanna are out and says who will open will be a surprise.
Toss - Sri Lanka win the toss and choose to bat.

Hello and welcome to the 4th ODI between Sri Lanka and Australia. This time around, Australia have a 2-1 lead in the 5-match series and will be looking to seal the win. The Lankans will have other plans as they drove a hard fight in the last match. They will be playing in Dambulla again, this time with more turn, so runs will be hard to come by. Both sides have their motivation and both have got a good sense of their opposition, so this will be an interesting match to follow. So, sit back as we take you through an exciting day of cricket.
